neighbours.label: the piece 'uf' or 'eb' right after K, Q or T in a rare name (K|uf|a, Q|uf|u, K|eb|ili), as opposed to some other pieces after the same letters (Q|uba, T|swana); K|wan and Q|abo also fire and are not claimed
fire: The old town of Kufa lies on the Euphrates.
The temple of Confucius stands in Qufu in Shandong.
The coins carry an inscription in Kufic script.
The writer Tufail lived in Lahore for many years.
The oasis of Kebili lies in southern Tunisia.
Climbers walk up Kebnekaise in northern Sweden.
The Malay word Kebangsaan means national.
The town of Kufstein stands on the Inn.
quiet: The old town of Kandy lies in the hills.
The temple of Quba stands in Medina in Arabia.
The stones carry an inscription from Kadesh in Syria.
The Tbilisi writer lived in Gori for many years.
The oasis of Qena lies in southern Egypt.
Climbers walk up Kibo in northern Tanzania.
The Kikuyu word for it means national.
The town of Qom stands on the plain.

short: the piece uf or eb after K, Q or T in a rare name
notes: Card: 'eb' x3, 'uf' x2, 'wan' x2, 'ab' x2, 'war' x2, 'ep' x2. Probes: K|uf|ra 0.67, K|eb|ir 0.52, Q|eb 0.56, T|uf|nell 0.48, K|eb|bede 0.33; K|ano 0.01, K|adesh 0.03, Q|uba 0.04, T|swana 0.02, K|ik 0.12, K|ib 0.19. Pieces outside the label also fire: K|wan 0.64, Q|abo 0.43, Kw|a|Z 0.73, T|sh|w 0.41, so this covers only a part of the pole, and the wider pattern is not understood. Pieces checked with the tokenizer.
